What we do

In the chair

Men's haircuts and tapers

Classic cuts at a fair price, in a four-chair shop with TVs on.

Beard and eyebrow trims

Including razor shaves — Jay is the name one regular gave for a beard trim and head shave.

Kids in the chair

Families come in, and long-term regulars bring the next generation.

Walk-ins welcome

A traditional shop atmosphere — conversation, humor, and customers treated like regulars.

Our story

A downtown Edmond landmark

Doc's Barber Shop is at 217 S Broadway in downtown Edmond, with a 4.7-star Google rating from 115 reviews.

Customers name barbers including Doc, Jay, and Cameron. Regulars talk about coming back for 20 years, and about the muraled Route 66-style shopfront you can't miss from the street.
